nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting sales per address, incremented unchecked on every transferFrom.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist that lets an address bypass the ensure() sale-condition checks.
Private minimum sale amount, set by init() and enforced in condition().
Private maximum sale amount, set by init() and enforced in condition().
Private maximum number of sales allowed per sender, set by init() and read in condition().
Address treated as a trusted trade counterparty inside ensure(); writable by owner via setTradeAddress().
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances, mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom/batchSend.
Public mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spend allowances, written by approve() and transferFrom().
Constant public decimals (18) used by init() to scale sale limits.
Public total token supply initialised in the constructor.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Private privileged account; serves as the sole access-control guard for delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress and as whitelist in ensure().
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view guard implementing the owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale whitelist, otherwise delegating to condition().
Public payable transfer that mutates allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum directly without SafeMath.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit check using _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-gated function that performs a delegatecall to an arbitrary attacker-supplied address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-gated initialiser that sets _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum from token amounts.
Owner-gated batch distribution whose total = _value * _tos.length and balance updates are unchecked.
Owner-gated setter for the trusted tradeAddress used inside ensure().
Internal pure Uniswap pair-address derivation used by ensure().
Payable constructor that mints the full supply to msg.sender, sets owner and pre-approves the Uniswap router.
Caller-controlled address used as sender, spender and access-control subject across the contract.
Raw delegatecall to an arbitrary address with attacker-supplied calldata executed in contract storage context.
total = _value * _tos.length computed without SafeMath and can overflow.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath and can overflow.
Recipient parameter of transfer(), forwarded to transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transfer(), forwarded to transferFrom().
Source account parameter of transferFrom(), checked against whitelist and debited.
Recipient parameter of transferFrom(), credited unchecked.
Amount parameter of transferFrom(), used for allowance, balance and sale-count updates.
Attacker-influenced target address of the delegatecall.
Attacker-influenced calldata executed via delegatecall.
Sale-count limit assigned to _saleNum in init().
Minimum sale amount scaled by decimals and assigned to _minSale.
Maximum sale amount scaled by decimals and assigned to _maxSale.
Recipient array of batchSend(), its length multiplies _value to form total.
Per-recipient amount of batchSend(), multiplied by recipients and added to balances.
Local pair address derived by pairFor() and compared against _from for whitelisting.
Loop counter iterating over the _tos recipient array.
Local total = _value * _tos.length, the unchecked multiplication result.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
msg.sender is supplied as _from when transfer calls transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as _from and as spender inside transferFrom.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure() grants a whitelist bypass whenever _from or _to equals owner.
ensure() reads the canSale whitelist to bypass the sale condition.
ensure() treats tradeAddress as a trusted sender that bypasses condition().
ensure() falls back to condition(_from,_value) when no whitelist matches.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address for the whitelist check.
transferFrom debits allowance[_from][msg.sender] when the caller is not the owner.
transferFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] and increments balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] without any bounds check.
condition() reads _saleNum to cap the number of sales per sender.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer size.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer size.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
delegate() reaches an arbitrary delegatecall guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner).
delegate() authenticates the caller through msg.sender == owner.
init() authenticates the caller through msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() authenticates the caller through msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() authenticates the caller through msg.sender == owner.
approve() records msg.sender as the allowance owner.
init() assigns the scaled token amount to _minSale.
init() assigns the scaled maxToken amount to _maxSale.
init() assigns saleNum to _saleNum.
init() scales token and maxToken by 10**decimals.
batchSend() credits balanceOf[_to] in a loop without SafeMath.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length which can overflow.
batchSend() performs balanceOf[_to] += _value which can overflow.
setTradeAddress() writes the trusted tradeAddress used by ensure().
constructor stores msg.sender as owner.
constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied _supply.
constructor stores the token name.
constructor stores the token symbol.
constructor credits the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
approve() writes the requested amount into allowance.
The arbitrary delegatecall executes external code in this contract's storage context and can re-enter any function.
